note: Preview Link defines a 'preview_link' content entity (UUID token + dynamic_entity_reference 'entities' + expiry) and grants token-based view access to unpublished content. Config object preview_link.settings holds enabled_entity_types (map entity_type => [bundles], empty list = all bundles), expiry_seconds (default 604800), multiple_entities (true), display_message (always/subsequent/never). Service preview_link.host answers hasPreviewLinks()/getPreviewLinks()/isToken(). Permissions: 'generate preview links', 'administer preview link settings'. Medium/hard grounded in the real settings config and in live preview_link entities created for a namespaced 'PL Hard Target' Article node.

evals.prompt: A client without a Drupal account needs to preview an unpublished article. Which module solves this and how does an editor produce the link the client can open?
evals.expected_output: Preview Link. Enable the entity type in its settings, then on the entity use the 'Preview Link' tab (path <canonical>/generate-preview-link) to generate a unique tokenised URL. Opening the canonical URL with the valid preview_token grants view access to the unpublished entity even for anonymous users.

evals.prompt: In the Preview Link module, which configuration object and keys control which entity types can have preview links and how long a link stays valid? What is the default lifetime?
evals.expected_output: Config object preview_link.settings: enabled_entity_types (entity type => list of bundles; empty list means all bundles), expiry_seconds (link lifetime, default 604800 = 7 days), multiple_entities, display_message. Edited at /admin/config/content/preview_link.

evals.prompt: Which Preview Link permission does an editorial role need in order to create preview links for content?
evals.expected_output: The 'generate preview links' permission. ('administer preview link settings' is a separate admin permission for the settings form.) Viewing a previewed entity needs no permission — a valid preview_token grants access.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Preview Link module's link lifetime has been customized. Inspect the live configuration and state how many seconds a preview link stays valid.
evals.expected_output: expiry_seconds is 3600 in preview_link.settings (read via `drush config:get preview_link.settings expiry_seconds`).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, exactly one content type has been enabled for Preview Link. Inspect the live configuration and state which entity type and bundle are enabled for preview links.
evals.expected_output: The node Article bundle is enabled: preview_link.settings enabled_entity_types = { node: [ article ] }.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, configure the Preview Link module so that the Article (node) content type is enabled for preview links. Apply the change to the live configuration.
evals.expected_output: preview_link.settings enabled_entity_types.node includes 'article' (or is an empty list meaning all node bundles).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is an unpublished Article node titled 'PL Hard Target'. Using the Preview Link module, generate a preview link for that node so it can be previewed via a tokenised URL. Apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: A preview_link entity referencing the 'PL Hard Target' node exists and is unexpired, so preview_link.host->hasPreviewLinks($node) is TRUE. Create it via the preview_link entity storage (setEntities([$node]) then save).
